channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ethiopian army says 272 Tigrayan fighters killed in Amhara
item.description: Tigray People’s Liberation Front says in a 'situation of full-blown war' with Ethiopia's government.

item.title: Iranian-American group sues Trump over war
item.description: Plaintiffs have families in Iran who have been harmed by the US war, they say.

item.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan
item.description: Four civilians have been killed in the latest Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says shot down 6 ballistic missiles launched by Houthis
item.description: No response by Yemen's Houthis to a claim by the coalition forces that its missiles targeted Taif and Yanbu.

item.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
item.description: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

item.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
item.description: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

item.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
item.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

item.title: In Amish country, nurses go door to door to stop deadly spread of measles
item.description: With four measles-related deaths in Pennsylvania, health officials are hoping to get people on board with vaccines in private.

item.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
item.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

item.title: Watch: UN delegates walk out of Netanyahu speech
item.description: The Israeli delegation could be be seen cheering in support during Netanyahu's speech.
